name: preflight-gate-2-ip
displayName: Biotech Pre-Flight Checklist — Gate 2 IP screen
description: The IP search of Step 2 (the fatal-flaw screen) of the Biotech Venture Qualification Framework: a preliminary freedom-to-operate screen that finds whether an in-force patent claim reads on the essential elements of a biotech or medtech invention, from opened patent pages, and returns clear / wall / unknown with a kit to take to patent counsel. Screening only, not legal advice.
